Assam's Barak Valley sees 148 newborn deaths; infrastructure issues cited

Assam's Barak Valley has reported 148 newborn deaths over a three-month period, primarily attributed to birth asphyxia and low birth weight. Cachar district recorded the highest number of fatalities. Rural healthcare infrastructure deficiencies and delays in patient referrals have been identified as contributing factors to the situation, prompting concern from the Chief Minister's office.
